top_findings: No off-site footprint: not in Common Crawl, no listings, mentions or sameAs profiles
Thin, templated pages: nine use-case pages at 388-435 words from one skeleton; three topic pages at 370-565 words
Page-type mismatch: /manus-alternatives targets a list query but names no alternatives; topic pages are product pages where guides rank
Homepage weight: 1.07 MB raw HTML (95 inline SVGs), ~822 KB gzip JS, Clerk on every marketing page
No proof of experience: no about page, screenshots, video, case studies or named author
quick_wins: 301 www.kraftybot.app to the apex (serves a 200 duplicate today)
Add /download to the sitemap, trim four long meta descriptions, extend the homepage footer to the 11 unlinked pages
Add sameAs, seller and ContactPage to the schema; replace the personal Gmail contact with a role address
Add the four topic pages to llms-full.txt and give llms.txt links their own descriptions
Verify Bing Webmaster Tools, enable IndexNow, set a PageSpeed Insights API key for the next audit
not_measured: Field and lab Core Web Vitals (no Google API key; PageSpeed Insights rate-limited; Lighthouse not installed)
Referring domains and link quality (no Moz or Bing key)
Google indexation and impressions (no Search Console)

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: All 20 sitemap URLs return 200, self-canonical, no robots meta or X-Robots-Tag
Server-rendered, raw and rendered text match, 0 console errors
http to https single 301; trailing slash 308; true 404 with noindex
HSTS, nosniff, X-Frame-Options DENY, frame-ancestors none, Referrer-Policy, nonce CSP
Unique titles and descriptions on every page

findings.title: Homepage HTML is 1.07 MB raw
findings.description: https://kraftybot.app/ is 1,068,730 bytes raw (95 KB gzip); 95 inline SVGs account for 862 KB; inner pages are 38-68 KB.
findings.recommendation: Move SVGs to static files or a sprite; lazy-render below-fold sections.

findings.title: No www redirect
findings.description: https://www.kraftybot.app/ returns 200 with a canonical to the apex.
findings.recommendation: 301 www to apex.

findings.title: Marketing pages are uncacheable
findings.description: cache-control: private, no-cache, no-store on public pages because of the per-request CSP nonce.
findings.recommendation: Use script hashes on marketing routes or inject the nonce at the edge so the CDN can cache.

findings.title: Loose CSP
findings.description: connect-src, frame-src, img-src and media-src include bare https:; script-src carries unsafe-inline.
findings.recommendation: List explicit origins only.

findings.title: /download missing from sitemap
findings.description: /download is linked, returns 200, self-canonical and indexable but is not in /sitemap.xml.
findings.recommendation: Add it in app/sitemap.ts or noindex it on purpose.

findings.title: HSTS without includeSubDomains or preload
findings.description: max-age=31536000 only.
findings.recommendation: Add includeSubDomains; preload once all subdomains are HTTPS.

findings.title: No Permissions-Policy header
findings.description: Header absent.
findings.recommendation: Add a restrictive policy.

findings.title: Long meta descriptions on four topic pages
findings.description: /manus-alternatives 195, /autonomous-ai-agent 186, /ai-agents-for-business 173, /ai-employees 163 characters.
findings.recommendation: Trim to about 155.

findings.title: 404 page reuses homepage description
findings.description: Also has two duplicate robots noindex tags.
findings.recommendation: Own description, single robots tag.

findings.title: OG image served with max-age=0
findings.description: /brand/krafty-social-v1.jpg is versioned by filename.
findings.recommendation: Long max-age, immutable.

findings.title: Sitemap lastmod equals deploy date
findings.description: 16 of 20 lastmod values are 2026-10-26; priority is set and ignored by Google.
findings.recommendation: Per-page content dates; drop priority.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Accurate, plain copy with no false claims; Flesch 60-81
Prices and limits stated openly and consistent everywhere
Clear definition sentence and llms.txt (AI citation readiness 74)
/how-it-works is a strong 772-word page

findings.title: Nine use-case pages are thin and templated
findings.description: 388-435 words each from one heading skeleton with five identical sentences; 45-51% unique against siblings, 40-45% once the hub (which repeats every starter prompt) is counted.
findings.recommendation: Add a sample output, first-run walk-through and role-specific questions per page; 700+ unique words; cut hub prompts to teasers.

findings.title: Little proof of experience or authority
findings.description: E-E-A-T: Experience 38, Expertise 60, Authoritativeness 30, Trust 70. No about page, author, case study, screenshot or video.
findings.recommendation: Add /about, 2-3 case studies with real outputs, real screenshots, a demo video.

findings.title: Topic pages restate the same features
findings.description: /ai-agents-for-business (565 words), /ai-employees (416), /autonomous-ai-agent (370) all repeat memory, apps, cloud computer, approvals with keyword-forced H2s.
findings.recommendation: One distinct angle per page; link the feature list to /how-it-works.

findings.title: /manus-alternatives lists no alternatives
findings.description: 419 words; says it does not publish comparisons; every result for the query is a list or directory.
findings.recommendation: Owner decision: retarget to a vs page, build a cited alternatives guide without scores, or redirect.

findings.title: Trust gaps
findings.description: Support is a personal gmail.com address; no legal entity, address or security page.
findings.recommendation: Role address on the domain; data and security page; entity in terms.

findings.title: No blog or guides section
findings.description: No informational content beyond the topic pages.
findings.recommendation: Start with the five cluster-plan pages.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Unique titles; one H1 per page matching its query
Correct canonicals; no templated metadata detected
Inner pages link each other well; breadcrumbs present

findings.title: Homepage footer omits 11 public pages
findings.description: The homepage uses a shorter footer that omits /autonomous-ai-agent, /manus-alternatives and all nine use-case pages.
findings.recommendation: Reuse the inner-page footer or link each homepage use-case tab to its page.

findings.title: Several pages compete for 'AI agent'
findings.description: Pillar H1 targets the enterprise-leaning 'AI agents for business'; three pages chase the head term.
findings.recommendation: Pillar takes 'AI agents for small business'; /ai-employees the role framing; /autonomous-ai-agent the definition.

findings.title: Page-type mismatch on topic and use-case queries
findings.description: Guides, definitions and lists rank for every target query; kraftybot.app serves 244-565 word product pages. SXO gap scores 37-45/100.
findings.recommendation: Add a guide layer: question H2s, direct answers, named competitors, sample output, FAQs; retarget support triage to 'AI support ticket triage'.

findings.title: Short titles and long descriptions on topic pages
findings.description: Titles 27-36 characters; descriptions 163-195.
findings.recommendation: About 55 and 155 characters.

findings.title: Homepage H1 extracts without a separator
findings.description: Reads 'AI that does the workKrafty Bot' in extracted text.
findings.recommendation: Add a space or aria-label.

findings.title: Card and page claims differ
findings.description: Sales Outbound card claims LinkedIn drafts and intent scoring the page does not mention.
findings.recommendation: Align card and page.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Valid server-rendered JSON-LD graph with @id links
SoftwareApplication with category, OS, offers (0 and 20 USD/month matching copy), featureList
Organization with logo, contactPoint, founder
BreadcrumbList correct on inner pages
Nothing deprecated

findings.title: No sameAs on Organization
findings.description: No profile URLs anywhere in the code.
findings.recommendation: Add real profiles once they exist.

findings.title: No aggregateRating or review
findings.description: SoftwareApplication cannot qualify for the software rich result.
findings.recommendation: Add only when real, verifiable ratings exist.

findings.title: contactPoint uses a personal Gmail address
findings.description: Public schema exposes a personal email.
findings.recommendation: Role address on the domain; add availableLanguage.

findings.title: /support and /privacy have no JSON-LD
findings.description: No breadcrumb either.
findings.recommendation: ContactPage and WebPage blocks with BreadcrumbList (snippets in findings/schema.md).

findings.title: Offers lack seller
findings.description: FOUNDING50 promo not modelled (optional).
findings.recommendation: seller: {@id: #organization}.

findings.title: FAQPage present on three pages
findings.description: Google retired FAQ rich results for all sites on 2026-05-07; markup is valid.
findings.recommendation: No action; do not add more for SERP benefit.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Warm TTFB 0.15-0.23 s on all sampled pages
Two woff2 fonts preloaded and cached immutable
Only one third party (Clerk); no images so CLS risk is low
Inner pages are 12-13 KB gzip

findings.title: Core Web Vitals not measured
findings.description: No CrUX key; PageSpeed Insights rate-limited keyless calls; Lighthouse not installed. Score is provisional from lab weight signals.
findings.recommendation: Add a Google API key to the claude-seo config and rerun.

findings.title: Homepage JS about 822 KB gzip across 33 chunks
findings.description: Two chunks are 437 KB and 299 KB raw; subpages reference about 493 KB gzip.
findings.recommendation: Dynamic-import the chat demo and below-fold sections; expected saving 300-500 KB gzip.

findings.title: Clerk loads on every marketing page
findings.description: clerk-js 84 KB plus @clerk/ui 46 KB gzip for signed-out visitors.
findings.recommendation: Load only on app and auth routes.

findings.title: Homepage DOM is 2,470 elements with 95 inline SVGs
findings.description: Mobile parse cost and INP risk.
findings.recommendation: SVG sprite and lazy render; expected 50-70% raw HTML reduction.

findings.title: Four render-blocking stylesheets
findings.description: Main sheet 40 KB gzip / 260 KB raw.
findings.recommendation: Purge unused CSS; split marketing CSS.

findings.title: HTML served gzip, not brotli
findings.description: Content-Encoding: gzip.
findings.recommendation: Enable brotli at the edge.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: robots.txt allows every search, fetch and training bot explicitly
llms.txt follows llmstxt.org; all 21 links return 200
Clear definition sentence on /, /how-it-works and llms-full
Accessibility tree: 1,045 nodes, 84 interactive, 0 unnamed; landmarks present (agent readiness 78)

findings.title: No third-party footprint
findings.description: Zero results on Wikipedia, Hacker News, GitHub, YouTube; Product Hunt 404; not in Common Crawl.
findings.recommendation: Launch on Product Hunt and Show HN; directory and comparison listings; LinkedIn page; YouTube demo; then sameAs.

findings.title: /manus-alternatives names no alternatives
findings.description: Will not be picked for list-style queries by any AI engine.
findings.recommendation: Dated list of real alternatives with a criteria table, or retarget the page.

findings.title: llms-full.txt omits the topic pages
findings.description: 'Manus', 'autonomous' and 'AI employee' never appear; llms.txt descriptions reuse meta text.
findings.recommendation: Fix in lib/marketing/llms.ts and content.ts.

findings.title: Topic-page H2s are labels, not questions
findings.description: /ai-employees and /ai-agents-for-business never define their own term.
findings.recommendation: Question H2s with a 40-60 word direct answer under each.

findings.title: Homepage demo and mock form expose fictional data
findings.description: Fictional names, emails and timestamps in indexable HTML with an 11 px 'Example' label; the email-draft mock has about 12 unlabeled inputs.
findings.recommendation: Prominent example label in the demo text; neutral persona; aria-hidden or inert on the mock; aria-label on the demo form; consider data-nosnippet.

findings.title: Bing indexing unverified
findings.description: ChatGPT search and Copilot draw on Bing.
findings.recommendation: Bing Webmaster Tools and IndexNow.

findings.title: Draft agent standards absent
findings.description: No Content-Signal, Markdown delivery, WebMCP or /.well-known discovery files. Lighthouse agentic fraction not measured (PSI 429).
findings.recommendation: Optional; Content-Signal is a one-line robots.txt addition.

categories.name: Images
what_works: No missing alt text because there are no img tags
No unsized images, so no CLS from images
OG image is 1200x630 JPEG with alt text

findings.title: No images or video on any marketing page
findings.description: 0 img and 0 video tags across all pages; multi-modal score 35.
findings.recommendation: Alt-texted real screenshots of approvals and Bot output; a demo video with VideoObject schema.

findings.title: Dim secondary text likely under 4.5:1
findings.description: Hero subhead, breadcrumbs, timestamps and 'Example' label are dim gray on near-black.
findings.recommendation: Raise lightness; 12 px minimum.

phases.name: Phase 1: Quick wins
items: Add /download to sitemap; trim four long descriptions; extend homepage footer to the 11 unlinked pages
Schema: seller, ContactPage on /support, WebPage on /privacy, role email in contactPoint, real dateModified
Add topic pages to llms-full.txt; own descriptions in llms.txt
Bing Webmaster Tools + IndexNow; PageSpeed Insights API key; Search Console
Decide the /manus-alternatives direction; start the homepage weight work

phases.name: Phase 2: High-impact improvements
items: Deepen the nine use-case pages (700+ unique words, sample output, walk-through, role questions); cut hub prompts to teasers
Give each topic page one angle with question H2s and direct answers; retarget support triage
Cut homepage weight: SVG sprite, dynamic imports, Clerk off marketing routes, CSS purge
Label the demo chat as an example in its own text; aria-hidden the mock form
Add /about, real screenshots, demo video, 2-3 case studies; show the $20 price and a security page on every page

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & authority
items: Launch week: Product Hunt, Show HN, AlternativeTo, G2, Capterra, AI directories, LinkedIn, YouTube; then sameAs
Cacheable marketing pages (hash-based CSP or edge nonce); explicit CSP origins

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & iteration
items: Capture a drift baseline now; re-audit after launch week, then quarterly
Watch Search Console and Bing impressions for the 'ai agent for small business', 'human approval' and 'gmail' families
Monthly count of third-party pages mentioning Krafty Bot (target 10 within 60 days of launch)
PageSpeed Insights monthly once keyed; CrUX once traffic qualifies
Low backlog: HSTS preload, Permissions-Policy, OG image cache, brotli, sitemap lastmod, contrast, H1 separator
